jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Anduril’s Sheet Metal team sits within Development Manufacturing, where we turn fast-moving engineering concepts into physical hardware for some of the company’s highest-priority programs. This is not a high-volume production shop. We build low-volume prototype and development hardware, often working directly with design engineers while designs are still evolving. The parts we make move quickly into larger assemblies, testing, and field use, giving the team a direct line of sight from an engineering concept to real hardware supporting Anduril’s mission. We are intentional about developing versatile fabricators. Team members typically build depth in one area and then cross-train across laser cutting, waterjet, press brake, forming, finishing, and other fabrication processes. You do not need to arrive knowing every machine or process. We value people who are mechanically curious, accountable, willing to learn, and motivated to grow their craft. ABOUT THE JOB As a Sheet Metal Fabrication Technician — Prototype Development , you will help turn engineering designs into finished hardware. You may start with a CAD model, drawing, or developing concept and carry the work through flat pattern development, cutting, forming, finishing, inspection, and delivery. When something breaks in a deployed environment, we fix it. About the Role We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join the Imaging team. This is not a product development role, and it isn't a traditional cloud-SRE role either. You are the frontline for keeping fielded imaging systems alive: the person field personnel and customer-support escalations turn to when a deployed system isn't behaving. You'll be the second SRE on a small, high-trust team, working directly with our lead, with real room to shape how Imaging reliability and support operate as we scale. The work is varied and often ambiguous. You might spend a morning triaging a networking failure on a system being stood up at a remote site, an afternoon walking a field operator through a sensor calibration over the phone, and the back half of a week hardening a runbook so the next person never has to solve that problem live again. When a fielded system misbehaves, the root cause could be anywhere in the stack--and you're the one who narrows it down. The satellite bus is the platform – the payloads are the mission. jobs.description_text: For more information, visit www.newsbreak.com/about About the team The User Signal team sits at the heart of our in-house advertising platform. We collect, process, and activate user signals — behavioral events, contextual data, engagement history, and identity signals — and turn them into the features and audiences that power ads targeting, bidding, and ranking across the company's ad stack. The quality of our signals directly determines how well every downstream ML model performs: better signals mean better targeting, higher CTR/CVR, and stronger monetization. We own the full lifecycle — from raw event ingestion and large-scale feature pipelines, to identity-prediction models, embeddings, and online serving — and we close the loop by applying those outputs inside the ads models that consume them in real time. You will own significant pieces of the signal-to-model pipeline end to end: defining and building features at scale, developing models for user understanding — most importantly identity prediction — and then applying those predictions directly inside the ads targeting, bidding, and ranking models to drive measurable lift. Infinite Medical P.C. is a nationwide network of advanced practice providers and specialty clinicians committed to delivering high-quality, proactive care to residents of skilled nursing and long-term care facilities. Through our partnership with MedElite Healthcare Management Group, we provide coordinated, patient-centered services designed to improve clinical outcomes and address the unique medical and behavioral health needs of residents. Together, we promote collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement in senior care. Position Summary Infinite Medical P.C. is seeking a dedicated Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Behavioral Health Care Manager within our Collaborative Care Model (CoCM) program. This is an in-office, non-face-to-face care management position . The LPN Behavioral Health Care Manager remotely supports residents in skilled nursing and long-term care facilities through medical record review, behavioral health screening, care planning, registry management, care-team collaboration, and psychiatric case consultation. The Behavioral Health Care Manager works as part of an integrated care team that includes the treating medical provider, psychiatric consultant, clinical leadership, facility staff, and other members of the patient’s care team.
